title: Add conditional bar transparency option

leads.summary: Shared wallpaper sampling drops changes that arrive while the helper is running
leads.consequence: If a wallpaper/theme/position update arrives during an ImageMagick run, its timer may fire while transparentForegroundProc.running is true, and refreshTransparentForeground returns without remembering the update. The previous run's valid hex output is then accepted and useTransparentForeground stays true, so the bar can retain the prior contrast color indefinitely until another explicit refresh. Unlike BarPanel:1404-1416,1469-1475, the shared process has no pending flag or onRunningChanged retry. Keep a pending request and restart once the shared process exits, also avoid accepting stale output when configuration changed.
leads.triage: behavioural -> Opus follow-up-1; confirmed with harness (review11). Pre-existing race on base; PR's F6 reuse guard removes accidental correction. Published as small finding N1.

leads.summary: Related open #8615 changes color helper output to three colors; this PR rejects all of it
leads.consequence: #8615 defaults omarchy-bar-text-color to one line containing three space-separated hex values, and only its --single option restores one hex. Both of this PR's process commands omit --single, and both readers require exactly one #RRGGBB. With the other helper installed as-is, normal transparent:true never passes its contrast gate, and per-monitor wallpaper colors never update; in conditional mode, transparent bars have the theme color instead. #8615's bar-text-color test also fails against its helper plus this PR's tests. The PRs are diverged, not stacked; their Bar.qml three-way merge has four conflict blocks and GitHub marks #8615 CONFLICTING. Reconcile both call sites/output parsers when resolving their overlap.
leads.triage: factual, verified via gh (#8615 helper prints three hex values by default; stale since 2026-09-08, already CONFLICTING). Base reader already requires one hex, so the contract clash predates this PR. Not published.

leads.summary: Related open #7568's dynamic CLI writes a value this PR's bar treats as solid
leads.consequence: #7568 adds omarchy bar transparent dynamic, which persists .bar.transparent = 'dynamic'. This PR applies only config.transparent === true and therefore disables requested transparency entirely for that value if both features are combined without explicit integration. The features also disagree on window policy: #7568 ignores floating windows and scopes the focused workspace, this PR counts all toplevels per monitor. They are diverged, not stacked, and their Bar.qml three-way merge contains six conflict blocks, GitHub marks #7568 CONFLICTING. Decide a shared schema and precedence during merge, and add a test that writes dynamic via the CLI and reloads the combined bar.
leads.triage: factual, verified via #7568 diff and body (dynamic mode, focused workspace, floating-only counts as empty); also confirmed by Opus in self-check. Published as related-PR note N5 without the combined-runtime claim.

leads.summary: Document both opt-in transparency flags in the shipped bar configuration references
leads.consequence: The default shell.json ships both false, but the shipped bar example, full shell schema, shell overview and user manual all show only bar.transparent. Existing user shell.json files are canonical rather than deep-merged, so editing those files is required to enable either opt-in; no user-facing reference shows their names or how they combine with bar.transparent. Include the two fields and conditional/per-monitor behavior in the bar README and update the manual and schema examples or cross-link them.
leads.triage: already in Opus final (Q2 item 3); Opus follow-up confirmed manual and shell/README locations. Published as N3.

leads.summary: New transparency fixture cannot detect loss of per-surface pending recolor
leads.consequence: The new VM fixture tests the shared sampler and a stub of onTransparentChanged, not the new per-monitor scheduleTransparentForegroundRefresh/onRunningChanged pair. Replacing foregroundRefreshPending=true with false when a per-monitor helper is running lets wallpaper, theme and screen-size changes vanish behind an in-flight sample, yet both bar-transparency-test.sh and bar-test.sh pass. Add a test that starts a per-screen helper, changes the wallpaper/theme/size before it exits and asserts a subsequent helper launch uses the new arguments.
leads.triage: behavioural/test -> Opus follow-up-1 Q2; confirmed with mutants M5/M6. Published as Optional test improvement N2.

leads.summary: Pill foreground from related #13139 appears bypassed by per-monitor foreground selection
leads.consequence: If #13139's opt-in pills and this PR's transparentForegroundPerMonitor are both enabled, an opaque light pill over a dark wallpaper could receive the per-monitor white wallpaper text instead of #13139's dark pillForeground. This PR's per-surface barForeground takes local transparentForeground ahead of root.barForeground, and its helper call lacks #13139's --blend argument. The other PR's Bar.qml cannot be applied in full without conflict resolution, so this is a conditional integration hypothesis, not an observed combined runtime regression. Settle with a resolved merged QML and a contrasting pill/wallpaper fixture, then make the per-monitor foreground pill-aware.
leads.triage: hypothesis on #13139 pills + per-monitor foreground; not confirmed; dropped.

## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

Follow-up to the [earlier review of `30b88100`](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12446#issuecomment-5830152740) and the [author's reply](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12446#issuecomment-5849475638), checked at `4346ac35`.

**Verified:** all eight earlier findings are resolved at `4346ac35`, and no material regression was found in `82333b0f` or `4346ac35`. The changed tests pass on the head and on the head merged with the current `quattro` tip (`d3fb0284`). A few small notes follow.

| Earlier finding | Status at `4346ac35` |
| --- | --- |
| First-party panels lose one-click switching (`clickTargets`) | Resolved: `BarPanel` forwards `clickTargets` (`Bar.qml:1402`). Every `bar.<member>` that first-party code and `shell/Ui` read is forwarded, on the head and after the merge. |
| `plugin-auth-boundary-test.sh` failed; README described the shell root | Resolved: assertions updated. The static part passes on head and merge; the README describes per-monitor surfaces and third-party facades. |
| Per-monitor foreground could make popup text match the popup card | Resolved: `BarPanel.foreground` is `Color.popups.text` or `root.foreground`, never the wallpaper sample. Clock, weather and tray popups use `Color.popups.text`. |
| Stale special-workspace state after toggling the option | Resolved: the `activespecial`/`activespecialv2` listener runs regardless of the option (`Bar.qml:1219-1228`). |
| Ordinary `transparent: true` lost the wait-for-helper gate | Resolved: the bar clears only after a valid helper result, including when switching back from workspace mode. |
| Helper reruns on unrelated Hyprland events | Resolved: `BarModel.affectsTransparency` filters events, and `syncTransparency` reuses an existing colour. |
| Mixed monitors: third-party widgets and drag chrome followed the focused monitor | Resolved: facades are per slot, drag chrome reads its own screen's surface, and the shared colour stays while any monitor is transparent. |
| `--screen` used physical monitor size | Resolved: it uses `barWindow.screen.width/height` (logical), and the sampler reruns when that size changes. |

The new `bar-transparency-test.sh` fails against single-line reverts of the shared-foreground, startup-wake and reuse-guard changes, so it protects those fixes. Reverting the per-surface wait-for-helper binding (`Bar.qml:1378-1379`) is caught only by a source-text check in `bar-test.sh`.

**Correction to an earlier Verified note:** the earlier review gave `activespecialv2` as `ID,NAME,MON`. That matches Hyprland v0.56.2. On current Hyprland main, the first field is the workspace address; for special workspaces the address equals the name. `BarModel.specialWorkspaceEvent` does not read that field, so parsing is unaffected.

### Shared wallpaper sampler keeps a colour computed from old inputs

The root sampler (`Bar.qml:1161-1217`) handles an input change that arrives while its helper is still running like this:

```text
helper running (started with old theme/position; may already have read the old wallpaper)
  input changes -> scheduleTransparentForegroundRefresh() -> 120 ms timer
  timer fires   -> refreshTransparentForeground(): helper still running -> return  (request not remembered)
  helper exits  -> onRead applies the old-input colour; no rerun
```

This race already exists on the base. Before this PR, every `shell.json` re-apply took a fresh sample, which happened to correct a stale colour. Since `82333b0f`, the reuse guard in `syncTransparency` (`if (!useTransparentForeground)`, `Bar.qml:1152`) skips that resample. The same commit closed this gap in the per-surface sampler: it sets `foregroundRefreshPending` and reschedules from `onRunningChanged` (`Bar.qml:1412-1415, 1471-1476`).

**Impact:** small. A shared bar colour computed from the previous theme or position, and possibly the previous wallpaper, stays until the next wallpaper, theme or position change or transparency toggle. In workspace mode it is also resampled once every monitor is occupied and one empties again. This happens only when the timer fires before the helper exits. Established from a Node harness running the real `Bar.qml` sampler functions with a scripted timer and helper; helper runtime was not measured and nothing was rendered.

**Suggested change:** give the root sampler the same pending flag and `onRunningChanged` retry as the per-surface sampler.

**Optional test improvement:** no test exercises the per-surface retry. Setting `foregroundRefreshPending = false` (`Bar.qml:1413`), or disabling the retry condition at line 1472, leaves all changed tests passing, although a harness run shows the change is then lost. A test that changes the theme while a per-surface helper runs, and then checks for a second launch with the new arguments, would cover it.

### Smaller notes

- **Documentation:** `transparentOnlyWhenWorkspaceEmpty` and `transparentForegroundPerMonitor` do not appear in any documentation. The shell.json listing in `docs/omarchy-shell.md` (where `quattro` moved it from `shell/README.md`) and the example configs in `shell/plugins/bar/README.md` and `manual/05-the-top-bar.md` show `transparent` but neither new key. The custom-QML paragraph in `docs/omarchy-shell.md` does not mention `barForeground`, while the bar README now recommends `barForeground` for bar text.
- **Colour changes with both new options off:** tray symbolic icons on the bar now use `barForeground` (`Tray.qml:774`), so with `transparent: true` they follow the wallpaper contrast colour like the other bar widgets. Clock, weather and tray popups now always use `Color.popups.text`, while other panels still use `bar.text`. Shipped themes set both to the same value, so the popup change is invisible with them. The PR description states that defaults preserve existing behaviour; mentioning these two changes there would help maintainers.
- **Related open PR:** #7568 adds an overlapping `"dynamic"` value for `bar.transparent`. It uses a different window policy: the focused workspace only, with floating-only workspaces counted as empty. That differs from the per-monitor, all-windows policy here. Both PRs change `Bar.qml`, `BarModel.js` and the bar docs and tests.

## Review information

**Test scope:** Source review of `4346ac35`, `82333b0f`, `30b88100` and the base, plus Quickshell (main, 2026-09-25, and v0.3.1), Hyprland (main, 2026-09-26, and v0.56.2) and Qt Declarative source. In a sandbox, the PR's changed shell tests (Node and static portions) were run on base, head, `quattro` and head merged with `quattro`. The full `test/shell.d` suite was run on the merge and on `quattro`, with the same 11 failures on both, none in bar code, and no new ones. Also run: single-line mutants of `Bar.qml`, and Node harnesses executing the real `Bar.qml` functions with stubbed Hyprland objects. Compositor-dependent QML tests were skipped, no desktop session was used, and the author's live dual-monitor check was not repeated; visual effects are established from source, not observed.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, Opus 5.5 Xhigh technical review and final fact check, GPT 6 Sol Xhigh search for related issues, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.
